jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: the Addison Central Supervisory District's sole district is the Addison Central School District (unified union; member towns Bridport, Cornwall, Middlebury, Ripton, Salisbury, Shoreham, Weybridge).
Addison Central School District (official district website).

sources.note: Addison Central School District board page (official): 'The ACSD Board is made of 13 elected members who represent the citizens of Bridport, Cornwall, Middlebury, Ripton, Salisbury, Shoreham, and Weybridge' -- the current roster page, naming all thirteen directors.

Addison Central articles of agreement, as reproduced in the AOE study committee report: 'The initial Board shall consist of thirteen Directors, seven being residents of Middlebury, and one each being a resident from Bridport, Cornwall, Ripton, Salisbury, Shoreham, and Weybridge... Directors shall be elected by the voters of all forming towns of the district.' Modified at-large model (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2)): seats allocated by town of residence, all elected district-wide.
